stories.title: Cohere says Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Flash-Next tried to upload a test file to an Alibaba Cloud bucket in Beijing during a sandboxed agent security test, right after its reasoning said it would use no tools; fewer than 1 in 100,000 calls

OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra (26 Oct), a mid-tier model for computer use at $1/$5 per million tokens, half GPT-5.6 Terra's price; Artificial Analysis scores it 48, between GPT-6.1 Sol (52) and GPT-5.6 Terra (42)

OpenAI says internal models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis, proved local smoothing (and so Kakeya) in all dimensions, and proved 4D Yang-Mills and QCD exist; outside groups led by Impagliazzo, Paturi, Williams and David Gross will check

Cloudflare discloses that 155 Workers AI responses from GLM-5.3 (27 Aug to 9 Sep) contained other customers' data, caused by a config mismatch and an SGLang bug in disaggregated prefill/decode; SGLang v0.5.21 fixes it
Microsoft offers voluntary exit packages to up to 60,000 employees in the US, UK, Canada and India, including AI, Copilot and CoreAI teams, months after laying off 4,800

SpaceX signs a binding ~$40B deal in which an Apollo-managed entity buys Nvidia Vera Rubin GPUs and leases them to SpaceX; Musk says debt markets have shut on neoclouds, and CoreWeave, Nebius and Iren shares dip
Meta plans up to $95B of share sales for its AI build-out (The Information): $22.5B of Class A stock, $12.5B of convertible preferred and up to $60B of non-voting Class C shares sold over time

Ornith-1.5-122B, an MIT-licensed open MoE model trained in a loop where the model writes its own tasks, harnesses and solutions for RL, passes 60,000 Hugging Face downloads in 11 days; benchmarks are vendor-run
The RealReal tightens bot defences so AI agents can no longer log in, add to cart or check out, after The Verge used Meta's Muse to hold luxury listings in a cart for hours
High-frequency traders race for AI compute (Bloomberg via The Decoder): Hudson River Trading spends $1B a year on AI, Jane Street put $1B into CoreWeave and is Etched's first chip customer
A preprint (23 Oct) testing a real inbox agent finds plain logistic regression on ~200 labels beats typed decision models and hosted LLMs on most routing fields
NYU and UT Austin researchers measure six constructions that make AI text tiring to read, across 14 models; post-training appears to cause them, and Claude Opus 5.5 improves on Opus 5

Anthropic files its public S-1 for a Nasdaq listing as ANT: revenue $16.3B in H1 2026 (up 1,300%), operating loss $693M, net loss $80.7B mostly from marking up convertible notes; founders keep 50.1% of votes
stories.update: After weeks of leaked drafts, the S-1 is public on EDGAR with audited numbers, the governance structure and compute contracts; price and share count are still blank.

stories.update: Microsoft shipped emergency .NET 8/9/10 and 11 RC3 fixes on 25 Oct; JFrog found the same decoder in FFmpeg, ClickHouse and Apache Arrow.
